title: Good but could be improved
body: The app is intuitive and very useful, for example, when giving a speech or lecture. It could be improved if the vibration could also continue at the end until you turn it off. Also, it would be nice to have night mode (black background) which would save battery power
author: hyperaspites

title: Speculare
body: Gratuita, sempre a portata di mano, per l’autismo è molto utile, ma perché in senso antiorario? È un modo per disincentivare la versione gratuita? Se poteste sistemare sarebbe perfetta. Grazie mille.
author: gingorix

title: Pessima
